additionalScrollDeltaReview.head: 779b37b2f04eb88d23ade39f86588406312e620b
additionalScrollDeltaReview.activity: Fixed-commit read-only delta and authored evidence inspection. No tests, build, browser, model call or product write. The c73 review above is preserved as its own historical scope.

sourceFindingClosed.reason: The one-shot fromTop flag is set only for the three selected transitions: entering the file form, opening a provided source after successful save, and opening a provided source without a quote. toTop consumes the flag after the synchronous host.show call, overriding its inherited scrollTop. Early render exit clears the flag. Ordinary re-renders do not set it. Existing quote-centering and saved-reading scroll restoration remain separate.
sourceFindingClosed.ownership: The save branch still requires the captured state identity before opening the saved source; the new top request is set only inside that branch. The scroll correction does not add a new async action, mutate source data or change apply ownership.

additionalScrollDeltaReview.styleAssessment: Removing max-height40vh from rr-file-preview removes a declaration already overridden by the later equal-specificity rr-raw max-height:none. The removed overflow:auto would otherwise govern a separately constrained preview, but with no max-height it is not the scrolling boundary. The lens body remains the intended scrolling surface; no new source-level blocking regression found.

authoredEvidence.meaning: The model-free checker asserts a provided source opened from a scrolled reading starts at0 and returning restores274; that path uses1280x520 to create a nonzero reading position. At1280x800 it asserts the long full-list item opens at0 from list scroll1295, and file form open/save start at0 while same-form file re-render preserves3433. It records zero AI requests. The refreshed six-gate receipt continues to record the separately authored quote roundtrip and fake job boundaries.
authoredEvidence.limits: The full-list backTo0 is recorded rather than asserted to restore the material-list position; the source repair and RESULT do not claim full-list-position restoration. The file-form return-to-reading assertion starts from readingBefore0 in this fixture, so nonzero return preservation is established by the separate near.js reading path. The new checker does not independently cover a very long quote; existing six-gate assertions and Root observation remain the quote evidence. No authored or Root execution was repeated by this reviewer.
authoredEvidence.claimMatch: RESULT separates the1280x520 reading case,1280x800 full-list case and same-form re-render case, and labels the author-only mutation test as such. No additional model-quality claim was added.

additionalScrollDeltaReview.rootEvidenceReportedSeparately: Root reports the c73 normal selected-RQ fake job, leaving to home, ready without project mutation, explicit apply, exact reload, exact code/test quotes and back scroll/focus, then exact backup copy. Those observations are not re-executed here. Root still owns the new scroll UI check and CI40926559126 completion.

additionalAlertDeltaReview.head: d6c93dffa710e7947e73c319cbee079d5c540adf
additionalAlertDeltaReview.activity: Read-only exact delta inspection. No product writes, builds, test execution, browser use, model calls or repeated research. All previous review entries remain unchanged.

productDelta.assessment: The existing d.msg alert moves from after the long preview in fileBody to fileFooter immediately above the Save row. role=alert and the existing error styling remain. The footer is outside the scrolling body, so a long preview no longer carries the reason out of the visible pane. No message generation, validation, metadata, source bytes, save ownership or storage behavior changes in this delta. No new actionable P1/P2 found.

authoredVerificationAssessment.meaning: The new1280x720 case establishes preview text over3000 characters and body overflow over1500px. It triggers invalid UTF-8, an oversized file, version81 and origin301. For each reason it asserts the full alert rectangle lies within the viewport and the center hit-test lands on the alert or its descendant. It checks the long accepted preview remains exact, later verifies metadata and the last accepted filename remain, and asserts the saved entry is identical. This is stronger than only locating an alert node.
authoredVerificationAssessment.receipt: evidence/ui114-scroll.json records bad UTF-8 y602/bottom672 and the other three y621/bottom672, with zero AI requests. check-ui-114.mjs changes only the affected alert lookup from form to footer; the previous assertions are retained. RESULT describes the real Root-found visibility defect, the narrow move and the author mutation failure without calling it a model result.
authoredVerificationAssessment.limits: These executions and the mutation check are author evidence, not reviewer execution. A center hit-test detects central covering but does not prove every pixel is unobscured at all viewport sizes. The assertions directly support the selected1280x720 long-preview refusal boundary; they do not establish a general responsive-layout guarantee or final exact-CI success.

additionalAlertDeltaReview.next: Root owns locked build/check, actual long-file alert visibility and final CI. No additional source change is requested within this final single-delta review. The earlier model/source-kind and typed-evidence limitations remain.
